progress.fullBuildHint: A first build, compatibility build, or forced rebuild must process the Core and dependencies. ESP32 builds can take several minutes; the timer will keep updating.

doctor.title: Compile Doctor
doctor.collecting: Build health is collecting cache, lock-wait, and toolchain information…

healthy.explanation: Build evidence is complete and the cache and toolchain can be reused safely.
healthy.recommendation: No action is needed. Keep using the current configuration.

attention.explanation: The build can continue, but cache, environment, or fast-path eligibility changed.
attention.recommendation: Review the changes below. Continue if the configuration is expected.

problem.explanation: The toolchain reported an issue that needs attention. Raw evidence remains in the log.
problem.recommendation: Follow the issue-card action and try again.

toolchain.persistentHint: Verified installation-tree metadata and reused the previous strong-content result
toolchain.processHint: Verified lightweight package metadata and reused the toolchain identity from this process
toolchain.strongHint: Reverified the toolchain content used by this target

certified-evidence-available.label: FLFE Core {{coreVersion}} · Evidence available
certified-evidence-available.detail: This Core is covered by bundled FLFE evidence. The full FQBN, toolchain, and build contract are still verified at build time.

local-certification-required.label: FLFE Core {{coreVersion}} · Local qualification required
local-certification-required.detail: This Core can build normally and uses the platform-native safe path until qualified. Qualified versions: {{versions}}.

safe-fallback.label: FLFE Core {{coreVersion}} · Safe fallback
safe-fallback.detail: This identity has no bundled FLFE evidence, but it can still build through the platform-native path.

forgeReason.unverified-core-version: This Core version has no FLFE evidence
forgeReason.qualification-core-version-mismatch: Local evidence belongs to a different Core version
forgeReason.missing-core-version: The current Core version could not be identified
forgeReason.invalid-core-version: The Core version format could not be verified
forgeReason.unverified-board-target: This board target has no FLFE evidence
forgeReason.qualification-fqbn-mismatch: Evidence does not match the complete FQBN
forgeReason.qualification-toolchain-mismatch: Evidence does not match the current toolchain content
forgeReason.qualification-contract-mismatch: Evidence does not match the current build contract
forgeReason.qualification-performance-regression: A/B performance did not meet the fast-path threshold
forgeReason.qualification-performance-unavailable: This identity lacks complete A/B performance evidence
forgeReason.builtin-performance-qualification-missin: This identity lacks bundled A/B qualification
forgeReason.builtin-toolchain-content-mismatch: Toolchain content differs from bundled evidence
forgeReason.builtin-toolchain-identity-unavailable: A strong toolchain identity is temporarily unavailable
forgeReason.unknown-platform: This platform is not covered by bundled FLFE evidence

missing_header.title: Missing header {{header}}
missing_header.summary: The compiler cannot find this header in the current environment. Search for the Arduino library that provides it, then check the selected board and Core version.

undeclared_symbol.title: Name {{symbol}} has not been declared
undeclared_symbol.summary: The program uses {{symbol}}, but no declaration or creation is visible in the current scope.
undeclared_symbol.suggestion: Make sure the variable, function, or object is created first, and check its spelling.

unknown_type.title: Unknown type {{typeName}}
unknown_type.summary: The compiler does not recognize {{typeName}}. Its declaration may be missing, its header may not be active, or the library version may not match.
unknown_type.suggestion: Check the initialization blocks and library dependencies, and confirm that the selected board Core supports this type.

missing_member.title: The current library has no {{member}} member
missing_member.summary: {{typeName}} does not provide {{member}}. A different library with the same name may be selected, or the API may not match this library/Core version.
missing_member.suggestion: Check the actual library path and installed version shown in the log.

redefinition.title: Duplicate definition of {{symbol}}
redefinition.summary: The name {{symbol}} is defined more than once.
redefinition.suggestion: Check for duplicate initialization, object, or variable blocks and keep only one definition.

conflicting_declaration.title: Conflicting declarations
conflicting_declaration.summary: The same name is declared with different types or forms.
conflicting_declaration.suggestion: Check duplicate variable, object, or function blocks and use one consistent name and type.

no_matching_function.title: Function arguments do not match the library API
no_matching_function.summary: The number or types of arguments do not match the function provided by the current library version.
no_matching_function.suggestion: Check the types and number of connected block inputs, then verify the library version.

argument_count.title: Incorrect number of function arguments
argument_count.summary: This call supplies a different number of arguments than the function requires.
argument_count.suggestion: Check for missing block inputs or an API change in the installed library version.

invalid_conversion.title: Incompatible data types
invalid_conversion.summary: The current value cannot be safely converted to the type required by the target parameter or variable.
invalid_conversion.suggestion: Check the value type connected to this block input.

expected_semicolon.title: The preceding generated code is incomplete
expected_semicolon.summary: The compiler expected a semicolon here. The actual problem is usually on this line or the statement immediately before it.
expected_semicolon.suggestion: Locate the nearby blocks and check whether text, expressions, or custom code are complete.

incomplete_syntax.title: Incomplete expression or statement
incomplete_syntax.summary: The compiler expected another symbol or expression at this position.
incomplete_syntax.suggestion: Check nearby blocks for empty inputs or incomplete expression connections.

stray_character.title: Unrecognized character in the code
stray_character.summary: The generated source contains a character that the compiler cannot accept.
stray_character.suggestion: Check text and custom code, replace full-width punctuation, and remove hidden characters.

generic.title: Source build error
generic.summary: The compiler found an error at this source location. The raw diagnostic is preserved below.
generic.suggestion: Locate the block and check its inputs, variables, and connections. For library files, verify the library and Core versions.

iram.title: Program exceeds the available IRAM
iram.summary: The linker reports that instruction RAM (IRAM) is full.

dram.title: Program exceeds the available DRAM
dram.summary: The linker reports that data RAM (DRAM) is full.

ram.title: Program exceeds the available RAM
ram.summary: The linker reports that the static data region is full.

flash.title: Program exceeds the current Flash partition
flash.summary: The linker reports that the program does not fit in the selected Flash partition.

target_region.title: Build output exceeds the target region
target_region.summary: The linker reports that a target memory region is full.

serial_port_unavailable.title: The selected serial port is unavailable
serial_port_unavailable.summary: The upload tool could not open the target serial port. Rescan ports and make sure no other application is using it.

esp_handshake_failed.title: The chip did not enter upload mode
esp_handshake_failed.summary: The serial port was handed to the upload tool, but the chip did not complete the handshake. Follow the BOOT/RESET steps for this chip.

physical_flash_mismatch.title: Flash configuration exceeds the board's measured capacity
physical_flash_mismatch.summary: CK stopped the upload before writing. Select a matching FlashSize and partition scheme in Board Settings.

environment_changed.title: Board or build settings differ from the last successful build
environment_changed.summary: The configuration change safely invalidates old cache entries, but it may not be the cause of this error.
environment_changed.suggestion: Review the specific changes and retry. You do not need to clear every cache.
